## Capacity-constrained scaling

With one city-wide e-ticket share (3.5%) some routes would carry several hundred people per bus, which is impossible; their riders simply use e-tickets more. 272 of 1479 routes were scaled down so that their busy-hour (p95) load fits a crush load of 80. Implied e-ticket share by route (quantiles): {0.25: 0.035, 0.5: 0.035, 0.75: 0.035, 0.9: 0.044}.
